You work accurately and reliably when creating documentation and maintaining data, including recurring tasks. Wir versprechen, dass wir Deine Startbahn für individuelles und berufliches Wachstum sein werden. As a Working Student or Intern (m/f/d) in the field of Land Systems / UGV Industrialization, you will support our team in Göppingen in establishing serial production for unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs). You will work closely with the Industrialization team and our external consulting partners, taking responsibility for clearly defined work packages in documentation, data management, and production planning preparation.

You will collaborate across Production, Engineering, Quality, and Logistics, gaining first-hand experience of a real production ramp-up from the very beginning and seeing how a prototype-based setup evolves into a scalable and repeatable serial production process.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Support the shopfloor planning activities at our Göppingen site by documenting current-state processes and contributing to layout planning, material flow design, and production cycle data (e.g., cycle times, workstation utilization, and walking distances).

  • Support process design activities by helping to structure and document assembly processes for different vehicle variants down to individual work-step level.

  • Create and maintain illustrated work instructions for production processes.

  • Collect, prepare, and analyze process-related data using Excel.

  • Support qualification and training activities by maintaining workstation-specific skill matrices and preparing training materials for assembly teams.

  • Prepare and follow up on workshops and alignment meetings with external consulting partners, including meeting minutes, task tracking, and status reporting.


What you bring to the team:

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Logistics, or a comparable field of study.

  • You are proficient in using Excel and PowerPoint; initial experience with CAD or layout planning tools is a plus.

  • First practical experience in manufacturing, workshop environments, or through academic projects is welcome, but not required.

  • You work accurately and reliably when creating documentation and maintaining data, including recurring tasks.

  • You have a structured and independent way of working and are willing to take ownership of your tasks and follow up on topics proactively.

  • You communicate openly and professionally and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from Production, Engineering, and external partners.

  • You are available to work regularly on-site in Göppingen; the scope and duration of your engagement can be tailored individually.

  • You have good German and English language skills.

  • You have experience using AI tools effectively.

Why Quantum-Systems:
